name: Open5e (D&D 5th Edition SRD)
description: 5th Edition System Reference Document ruleset providing entity schemas and sheet templates.

entities.name: Player Character
entities.description: A playable character with attributes, multiclass levels, spell slots, pact magic, equipment, and features.

entities.name: Monster / NPC Stat Block
entities.description: 5e Creature and Monster Stat Blocks with challenge ratings, action economy, and legendary actions.

entities.name: Item / Gear
entities.description: Generic items, equipment, adventuring gear, and magical items.

entities.name: Weapon
entities.description: Simple and martial melee and ranged weapons.

entities.name: Armor
entities.description: Wearable armor with base AC, dex caps, and strength/stealth rules.

entities.name: Shield
entities.description: Equippable shields providing armor class bonuses.

entities.name: Spell
entities.description: 5e Spells with level, school, casting time, range, and components.

entities.name: Character Class
entities.description: 5e Character Classes with hit dice, proficiencies, subclasses, and spellcasting.

entities.name: Character Race / Species
entities.description: 5e Races and species with speed, size, ability bonuses, and traits.

entities.name: Character Background
entities.description: 5e Character Backgrounds with skill proficiencies, tools, languages, and features.

entities.name: Feat
entities.description: 5e Feats with prerequisites, rules text, and mechanical benefits.

entities.name: Artificer Infusion
entities.description: 5e Artificer Infusions detailing prerequisites, item target types, attunement, and granted modifiers.

entities.name: Vehicle
entities.description: 5e Land, water, airborne, and siege vehicles with armor class, hit points, damage thresholds, and components.

templates.name: Standard Character Sheet
templates.description: Full interactive 5e character sheet matching the official 3-column print layout.

templates.name: Alternative Character Sheet
templates.description: 5e character sheet with saving throws and skills grouped by ability score.

templates.name: Spellcasting Sheet
templates.description: Dedicated 5e spellcasting sheet with cantrips, spell slots 1-9, and spell save DC.

templates.name: Creature Stat Block
templates.description: Monster manual style stat block with full actions, traits, and combat statistics.

templates.name: NPC Character Card
templates.description: Compact NPC card with 8 stat boxes and quick action summaries.

templates.name: Character List Item
templates.description: Uniform fixed-height quick-reference list item card with non-wrapping horizontal action row.

templates.name: Generic Entity Editor Form
templates.description: Schema-driven editor form that renders every property of an entity's schema, dispatching each field to a builtin or custom widget based on the entity definition's 'ui' descriptor.

templates.name: Field Dispatcher (internal)
templates.description: Recursive partial that resolves and renders the widget for each schema property. Not directly requestable; used via {{> field-dispatcher}} by entity_form and builtin-object-group.

templates.name: Text Input
templates.description: Default widget for string schema properties.

templates.name: Number Input
templates.description: Default widget for integer/number schema properties.

templates.name: Toggle / Checkbox
templates.description: Default widget for boolean schema properties.

templates.name: Select Dropdown
templates.description: Default widget for string schema properties with an 'enum'.

templates.name: Combo Box
templates.description: Default widget for string schema properties with 'examples': a freeform text input with a suggestion dropdown (HTML datalist), not restricted to those values.

templates.name: Simple Array List
templates.description: Default widget for array schema properties with primitive items.

templates.name: Object Field Group
templates.description: Default widget for nested object schema properties; recurses via field-dispatcher.

templates.name: Array of Objects Editor
templates.description: Reusable widget for an array (or key-object) of nested entities, e.g. attacks, feats, features_and_traits, class_levels. Recurses into the property's schema.items via field-dispatcher and supports add/remove.

templates.name: Ability Score Stepper
templates.description: Custom widget for a single ability score with +/- stepper controls.

templates.name: Action List Editor
templates.description: Custom widget for an array of name/desc action entries (actions, traits, legendary actions, etc.).
